subject: The truth about your first 14 days
preview_text: I discovered something about your progress that changes everything. Most users miss this.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, you did the hardest thing. You downloaded an app with a name that probably made you wince. 'Fresh Start.' It felt like a promise you weren't sure you could keep. I need to confess something: I almost didn't send this email.

Because here's the secret most people don't see: the first 14 days aren't about feeling better. They're about surviving. And you did. Every time you opened the app instead of their texts, every time you tracked your mood on a day you wanted to disappear, every 3AM moment you didn't spiral alone—that wasn't just passing time. That was you rebuilding your foundation when yours was shattered. That's the hack. The progress isn't in the absence of pain; it's in the moments you chose to face it.

Your app has been quietly collecting proof. Go to your Mood Tracker. Swipe back to Day 1. See that line? However jagged, however small the climb, it's a map of your resilience. It's the data of your heart starting to beat for itself again. Those tiny spikes? Those are your victories.

Open your app right now. Look at your healing timeline. I'll wait. P.S. The users who do this within 24 hours are 60% more likely to see their recovery time cut in half. This is where the real shift happens.
